title: Xenon ion acceleration
description: Essential: Correctly applies Newton's second law to find a = eE/M for xenon ions.

title: Electron energy relation
description: Important: Uses work-energy theorem for electrons to relate eEd to electron kinetic energy (½mv²).

title: Radial magnetic field
description: Essential: Correctly balances electric and magnetic forces on electrons to derive B₂ = E/v = √(mE/(2e)).

title: Particle number accounting
description: Important: Correctly uses the ratio k and total electron emission n to find ion production rate N = nk/(1+k).

title: Xenon ion final velocity
description: Important: Applies work-energy theorem to xenon ions to find v₁ = √(2eEd/M).

title: Thrust from momentum transfer
description: Essential: Correctly calculates thrust F' = N·Mv₁ using impulse-momentum theorem and gets final expression with all parameters.

title: Sign confusion in forces
description: Pitfall: Misapplies sign conventions for electron vs. ion charges in Lorentz force or acceleration equations.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Verifies dimensional consistency of final expressions for a, B₂, and F'.
